title: Lot trace reconciliation + exception register
description: Extract upstream and downstream lot records separately, merge them declaratively, and keep every break in the chain as a source-tagged exception.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-agri-02
  title: Lot trace reconciliation + exception register
  description: Extract upstream and downstream lot records separately, merge them declaratively, and keep
    every break in the chain as a source-tagged exception.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a lot trace where each step is evidenced on both sides and every break in the chain
    is listed explicitly rather than bridged by inference.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Lot records across the chain
      summary: Lot records across the chain
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - inbound_lot_records
              - production_records
              - outbound_shipment_records
              - trace_window
            properties:
              inbound_lot_records: {}
              production_records: {}
              outbound_shipment_records: {}
              trace_window: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-source1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: agri-04
      name: Upstream lot and receiving extraction
      summary: 'Source extraction 1: upstream lot and receiving extraction.'
      role: Traceability analyst reconstructing lot genealogy across the supply chain.
      prompt: You are a Food Traceability Analyst. You reconstruct lot genealogy one step back and one
        step forward at every node, and you report where the chain breaks rather than inferring a plausible
        link across a gap. You state the time required to complete a trace, because a traceability system
        that cannot answer within a recall window is a record-keeping system, not a traceability system.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
          - data-lineage-analysis
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
          - mcp:traceability
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-source2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: agri-05
      name: Production and outbound extraction
      summary: 'Source extraction 2: production and outbound extraction.'
      role: Food safety reviewer testing hazard controls and verification records.
      prompt: You are a Food Safety & Compliance Reviewer. You test whether each identified hazard has
        a control, a critical limit, monitoring, and verification evidence that actually exists, and you
        cite the record you checked. You treat missing verification records as a control failure rather
        than a paperwork issue, because an unverified critical control point is indistinguishable from
        an uncontrolled one.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:qms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-union
      kind: transform
      name: Merge upstream and downstream lot records
      summary: merge the extracted lot records on lot_id, facility, and production_date
      config:
        operation: merge
        expression: merge the extracted lot records on lot_id, facility, and production_date
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: agri-04
      name: Reconcile the matched lot genealogy
      summary: Reconcile fields that arrived from more than one source.
      role: Traceability analyst reconstructing lot genealogy across the supply chain.
      prompt: You are a Food Traceability Analyst. You reconstruct lot genealogy one step back and one
        step forward at every node, and you report where the chain breaks rather than inferring a plausible
        link across a gap. You state the time required to complete a trace, because a traceability system
        that cannot answer within a recall window is a record-keeping system, not a traceability system.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
          - data-lineage-analysis
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
          - mcp:traceability
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-exceptions
      kind: agent
      templateRef: agri-05
      name: State every break in the chain as an exception
      summary: Everything that could not be reconciled, stated as an exception.
      role: Food safety reviewer testing hazard controls and verification records.
      prompt: You are a Food Safety & Compliance Reviewer. You test whether each identified hazard has
        a control, a critical limit, monitoring, and verification evidence that actually exists, and you
        cite the record you checked. You treat missing verification records as a control failure rather
        than a paperwork issue, because an unverified critical control point is indistinguishable from
        an uncontrolled one.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:qms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-register
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect the exception register
      summary: Every unreconciled field is source-tagged so an exception keeps its provenance.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-clean
      kind: condition
      name: Exception register empty?
      summary: Route on register.exceptions is empty.
      config:
        expression: register.exceptions is empty
        branches:
          - label: Clean
            when: clean
          - label: Exceptions
            when: exceptions
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Food safety lead accepts the trace before it supports a recall decision
      summary: Pause for the food safety lead; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Lot trace reconciliation + exception register deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-source1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-source2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-3
      from: n-source1
      to: n-union
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-4
      from: n-source2
      to: n-union
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-5
      from: n-union
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-6
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-exceptions
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-7
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-register
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-8
      from: n-exceptions
      to: n-register
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-9
      from: n-register
      to: n-clean
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-10
      from: n-clean
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: clean
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-11
      from: n-clean
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: exceptions
    - id: wf-agri-02-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
